title.en: Rikon Suru Hazu Ga, Reikoku Kishi No Danna Sama Ni Dekiai Sareteita Youdesu

altTitles.ja: 離婚するはずが、冷酷騎士の旦那さまに溺愛されていたようです

altTitles.en: I thought our marriage was over… but my cold knight husband is madly in love with me

description.en:
“Please… Let’s Divorce!”

After her engagement was suddenly broken off, Iris found herself drowning in sorrow and betrayal.

But it wasn’t long before a marriage proposal arrived from the famous knight Wolf, known across the land as the “Crystal Ice Wolf” for his cold demeanor and fearsome presence.

Despite her hesitation, Iris agreed to the marriage, believing it was her duty as a noblewoman. But from the very first day, she was met with Wolf’s harsh coldness and distant attitude.

Just as she was beginning to adjust to her new life, Wolf left for war, leaving her alone in his mansion, surrounded by whispers and cruel glances from the servants.

Still, Iris endured it all and remained committed to fulfilling her role as his wife. But over time, she began to feel like nothing more than a burden to him.

In a moment of quiet sorrow, she wrote him a heartfelt letter, gently requesting a divorce—without bitterness or blame.

What she didn’t expect… was his shocking reaction.
The moment he read her request, something in him changed—
It was as if the ice around his heart had melted, and he began showing her a love she never imagined he held inside.

Had he always loved her but simply didn’t know how to express it?
And would fate now offer them a second chance to discover the love that had been hiding all along?

A tender love story between a cold knight and a kind-hearted heroine, brought together by chance, separated by walls… until one of them finally chose to break through.
